sections.blurb: Rigi is the summit reached by the Vitznau and Arth-Goldau rail lines, and it is free with the Travel Pass.

photos.caption: Rigi Kulm summit view over cloud-filled valleys toward the Alpine skyline
photos.author: Bybbisch94

photos.caption: Rigi Kulm summit terraces and station with the Alps beyond the cloud layer
photos.author: Bybbisch94

sections.blurb: Stoos is a car-free ridge village above Schwyz, reached by the world's steepest funicular, with the Fronalpstock ridge above it.

photos.caption: Fronalpstock with the Mythen peaks rising above cloud over the Schwyz valleys
photos.author: Waldindu

photos.caption: Alpine pasture and switchback path on the Stoos side of the ridge
photos.author: Badener

sections.blurb: Lauterbrunnen is a valley-floor village under 300 m cliffs, with the Staubbach Falls dropping about 300 m from the rock face above it.

photos.caption: Staubbach Falls above the church and meadows of Lauterbrunnen in spring
photos.author: Giles Laurent

photos.caption: Lauterbrunnen church and the Staubbach Falls above the river in autumn
photos.author: Sergio Ligregni

photos.caption: Lauterbrunnen valley with the village and falls under cloud, from a hillside view
photos.author: chensiyuan

sections.place: Jungfrau railway and the Eiger, Mönch and Jungfrau
sections.blurb: The Wengernalp railway climbs from Lauterbrunnen toward the Eiger, Mönch and Jungfrau above Kleine Scheidegg.

photos.caption: Wengernalpbahn train on the climb below the Eiger-Mönch-Jungfrau massif
photos.author: LiLaLu13

photos.caption: Fallbodensee reservoir with the Eiger and Mönch faces above it, in summer

photos.caption: Eiger, Mönch and Jungfrau massif above alpine meadows and switchback roads
photos.author: Daniel Reust

sections.blurb: Mürren is a car-free village at about 1,650 m, and the Schilthornbahn climbs from it to the Schilthorn at 2,970 m.

photos.caption: Schilthorn cable car and glass walkway with the Jungfrau massif behind
photos.author: Schilthornbahn

photos.file: Mürren is a Walser mountain village in Bernese Oberland, Switzerland.jpg
photos.caption: Mürren village street with steep rock faces rising behind the chalets
photos.author: Rosser1954

sections.blurb: The Riffelsee is a small lake on the Gornergrat side of Zermatt, and the Matterhorn is reflected in it on calm days.

photos.caption: Matterhorn reflected in the Riffelsee on a clear summer day
photos.author: BECK François

photos.caption: Matterhorn reflected in the Riffelsee at sunset, with a pink sky
photos.author: Deralpinbergsteiger

photos.caption: Matterhorn and the Riffelsee under the Milky Way at night
photos.author: Deralpinbergsteiger

sections.blurb: The Gornergrat is a rack-railway summit at 3,089 m above Zermatt, with the Gorner Glacier falling away below it.
